# hpe_morpheus_os_type (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "hpe_morpheus_os_type" "example" {
  name               = "Example OS Type"
  code               = "example.os.type"
  platform           = "linux"
  bit_count          = 64
  description        = "An example OS type"
  os_family          = "debian"
  os_version         = "22.04"
  install_agent      = true
  cloud_init_version = "2"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bit_count` (Number) The architecture bit count (e.g. 32 or 64)
- `code` (String) The code Morpheus uses as an internal identifier.
- `name` (String) The name of the osType.
- `platform` (String) The platform of the osType (e.g. linux, windows).

### Optional

- `category` (String) The category of the osType.
- `cloud_init_version` (String) The version of CloudInit being used
- `description` (String) The description of the osType.
- `install_agent` (Boolean) Whether to install the Morpheus agent on provisioned instances
- `os_codename` (String) The osCodename of the osType.
- `os_family` (String) The osFamily of the osType.
- `os_name` (String) The osName of the osType.
- `os_version` (String) The osVersion of the osType.
- `vendor` (String) The vendor of the osType.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) The ID of this resource.
- `owner` (String) The owner of the osType.

## Import

OS types can be imported using the `id`, e.g.

```bash
terraform import hpe_morpheus_os_type.example 123
```
